app.name: Painfold
app.tagline: Find what hurts your customers, without exposing who they are.

footer.promise: Open source. No cookies, no accounts, no tracking.

start.headline: Take the personal data out. Keep the feedback.
start.lead: Painfold removes {types} from support tickets and surveys. Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.
start.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file
start.dropAnywhere: Or drop a file anywhere on this page.
start.dropActive: Drop the file to read it.

importErrors.empty-file: This file is empty. Choose a file with a header row and at least one row of feedback.
importErrors.file-too-large: This file is larger than 50 MB. Split it into smaller files and clean them one at a time.
importErrors.no-rows: This file only has a header row. Add rows of feedback, or choose another file.
importErrors.too-many-rows: This file has more than 50,000 rows. Split it into smaller files and clean them one at a time.
importErrors.unsupported-format: Painfold reads CSV and XLSX files. Export your data in one of those formats and choose it again.
importErrors.legacy-excel: This is an old Excel file (.xls). Open it in Excel, save it as .xlsx or .csv, then choose it again.
importErrors.unreadable: This file could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected. Try exporting it again.

file.ragged: 1 row had a different number of cells than the header and was filled in. | {n} rows had a different number of cells than the header and were filled in.

columns.heading: What happens to each column
columns.keepHelp: Keep as is: copied to the cleaned file without checking.
columns.personal: Looks like personal data (“{term}”), so it is left out of the cleaned file.

find.failed: Something went wrong while checking the file. Try again, or reload the page.

review.heading: {findings} in {rows}
review.noFindings: No findings. Select any text that should be removed and press M, or continue.

note.title: {type}, row {row}
note.copies: Appears in 1 row. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}. | Appears in {n} rows. Removing it replaces every copy with {placeholder}.
note.nothingSelected: Select a finding to review it.
note.formOf: Looks like a form of “{marked}”, which you marked. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}.

mark.heading: Mark “{text}” as personal data
mark.noSelection: Select the missed text in a row first, then press M.
mark.overlap: The selection overlaps a finding. Select only the missed text.
mark.done: {type} marked in 1 row. | {type} marked in {n} rows.
mark.forms: 1 possible form to review. | {n} possible forms to review.

review.willRemove: 1 not reviewed will be removed. | {n} not reviewed will be removed.
review.limits: Automatic detection can miss personal data. Review the results before sharing the cleaned file. Painfold helps with data protection but is not legal advice and does not by itself make your processing GDPR compliant.

specimen.description: Example: a support ticket in which a phone number and an email address are replaced by placeholders.
specimen.before: Hallo, seit dem letzten Update kann ich keine Rechnungen mehr als PDF exportieren. Bitte rufen Sie mich unter

privacy.notice: Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.

download.heading: Your cleaned file is ready.
download.nothingRemoved: Nothing was found or marked, so the text is unchanged.
download.notReviewed: Includes 1 finding that was not reviewed. | Includes {n} findings that were not reviewed.
download.kept: 1 finding was kept. | {n} findings were kept.
download.noteInFile: The file ends with a note on the limits of automatic detection.
download.mapStays: The list of original values behind each placeholder stays in this browser and is gone when you close the tab.

network.none: No data has left this browser.
network.foreign: 1 request went to another site. | {n} requests went to other sites.
network.explain: Every request this page has made since it opened. Your file is read, checked and cleaned here, and never sent anywhere.
network.allOwn: All requests went to this site ({host}): the app's own code, fonts and text.
